# Greenlight Roofing and Remodeling

> > Owens Corning Preferred Contractor specializing in roof replacement, storm damage repair, and residential roofing services across Parker County, Tarrant County, and Johnson County, Texas.

Greenlight Roofing and Remodeling is a certified roofing contractor serving Hudson Oaks, Aledo, Weatherford, Dallas, and surrounding Texas communities. Led by Matthew Elliott, the company offers comprehensive roofing solutions including metal roofing, asphalt shingles, slate tile, and storm damage restoration with flexible financing options.
